en: Well done, everyone.{PAGE}This screening refused to remain{SAUT}as just a riveting treasure hunt.{PAGE}When the robot reawakened, it was as if{SAUT}my feelings were, how should I put it,{SAUT}"hit by a truck"―I burst into tears.{PAGE}You have my deepest gratitude for{SAUT}taking me through such a moving story.{PAGE}Please accept this as your reward.
Koromaru-san says he enjoyed{SAUT}spending time with you,{SAUT}{f 6 1 27 0 0 0}-san.
That reminds me, Aigis-san... You said{SAUT}both you and Koromaru sensed{SAUT}something in {f 6 1 27 0 0 0}-san.{PAGE}What exactly was it?
I'm sorry. Neither of us were able to{SAUT}come up with a clear answer.

Ahaha, weird.{PAGE}Well, no sense worrying about it, right?{SAUT}I mean, the fact that we're all here in{SAUT}the first place is weird too!{PAGE}I'm just glad to be here with everyone.{SAUT}Is that okay? Or is that weird?
Koromaru-san says, too, it is best to live in{SAUT}the present.{PAGE}I must agree.
*chuckle* You're right. I think things are{SAUT}just fine the way they are now!{PAGE}We've still got a ways to go, but we'll get{SAUT}through this if we work together.
Koromaru seems motivated too. Of{SAUT}course, I don't plan on sitting around{SAUT}either.
*giggle* We're all counting on you two!{SAUT}Let's do it, team!
